title: Consent for business KYC

purposes.title: Verify your business
purposes.description: Read your GST certificate, Udyam certificate, signatory ID and address proof and check them against the GST and Udyam registries, as required for telecom connections.

purposes.title: Install your services
purposes.description: Use your verified business address to plan and carry out the installation.

purposes.title: Order updates on WhatsApp
purposes.description: Send order and installation updates to your WhatsApp number. Optional.

dataCollected: Only the fields needed for verification: GSTIN, Udyam number, business and signatory names, designation, ID number and validity, address and bill date.
retention: Raw document images are deleted immediately after the fields are extracted. The extracted fields are kept only for the period required by telecom rules, as required by law (currently 2555 days), and then deleted.
rights: Withdraw your consent at any time before your service is installed; your extracted KYC data is deleted and the KYC stops. Once it is installed, telecom rules require us to keep these records for a live connection: contact our Grievance Officer.
Ask what data we hold about you and correct it.
Raise a grievance with our Grievance Officer, and then with the Data Protection Board of India.
